title: Sparse capacity-feasible experiments identify all forest offer coefficients
checked_scope: Alternative randomized research design for the source's known-forest pairwise offer model that respects the deployment count cap whenever K is at least two.
significance: Identifies the full coefficient array with exactly n+|E|+1 feasible assignment arms, proves conditional-mean minimality, and propagates simultaneous arm errors into allocation regret.
